title: Driving Score Dashboard

sql.statement: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM raw_business_data.objects WHERE is_deleted IS NOT TRUE

WITH spd AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT c.device_id, c.speed/100.0 AS kmh, c.latitude/1e7::numeric AS lat, c.longitude/1e7::numeric AS lon, LAG(c.speed/100.0) OVER w AS prev_kmh, LAG(c.latitude/1e7::numeric) OVER w AS prev_lat, LAG(c.longitude/1e7::numeric) OVER w AS prev_lon, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (c.device_time - LAG(c.device_time) OVER w)) AS dt_sec FROM raw_telematics_data.tracking_data_core c WHERE c.device_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND c.device_time < NOW() AND c.event_id IN (2, 802, 803, 804, 811) AND c.speed IS NOT NULL AND c.latitude <> 0 AND c.longitude <> 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_business_data.sensor_description sdc WHERE sdc.device_id = c.device_id AND sdc.sensor_type IN ('speed', 'acceleration')) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY c.device_id ORDER BY c.device_time)), veh_max AS (SELECT o.device_id, COALESCE(v.max_speed, 70) AS max_speed FROM raw_business_data.objects o LEFT JOIN raw_business_data.vehicles v ON v.object_id = o.object_id WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE), dv AS (SELECT s.device_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.prev_kmh IS NOT NULL AND s.dt_sec > 0 AND s.dt_sec <= 120 AND (s.prev_kmh - s.kmh) / s.dt_sec >= 10) AS brake_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.prev_lat IS NOT NULL AND s.kmh >= 30 AND ABS(atan2(sin(radians(s.lon - s.prev_lon)) * cos(radians(s.lat)), cos(radians(s.prev_lat)) * sin(radians(s.lat)) - sin(radians(s.prev_lat)) * cos(radians(s.lat)) * cos(radians(s.lon - s.prev_lon))) * 180 / pi()) >= 10 AND ABS(s.kmh - s.prev_kmh) >= 5) AS turn_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.kmh > COALESCE(vm.max_speed, 70)) AS speed_cnt FROM spd s LEFT JOIN veh_max vm ON vm.device_id = s.device_id GROUP BY s.device_id), vm AS (SELECT o.device_id, ROUND(SUM(t.trip_distance_meters) / 1000.0, 2) AS mileage_km FROM raw_business_data.objects o LEFT JOIN processed_common_data.trips t ON t.device_id = o.device_id AND t.trip_start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND t.trip_start_time < NOW() WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE GROUP BY o.device_id HAVING COALESCE(SUM(t.trip_distance_meters), 0) > 0) SELECT ROUND(AVG(GREATEST(0, 100 - 1.0 * COALESCE(dv.brake_cnt, 0) / vm.mileage_km * 100 - 1.0 * COALESCE(dv.turn_cnt, 0) / vm.mileage_km * 100 - 3.0 * COALESCE(dv.speed_cnt, 0) / vm.mileage_km * 100))::numeric, 1) AS value FROM vm LEFT JOIN dv ON dv.device_id = vm.device_id

WITH spd AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT c.device_id, c.speed/100.0 AS kmh, c.latitude/1e7::numeric AS lat, c.longitude/1e7::numeric AS lon, LAG(c.speed/100.0) OVER w AS prev_kmh, LAG(c.latitude/1e7::numeric) OVER w AS prev_lat, LAG(c.longitude/1e7::numeric) OVER w AS prev_lon, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (c.device_time - LAG(c.device_time) OVER w)) AS dt_sec FROM raw_telematics_data.tracking_data_core c WHERE c.device_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND c.device_time < NOW() AND c.event_id IN (2, 802, 803, 804, 811) AND c.speed IS NOT NULL AND c.latitude <> 0 AND c.longitude <> 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_business_data.sensor_description sdc WHERE sdc.device_id = c.device_id AND sdc.sensor_type IN ('speed', 'acceleration')) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY c.device_id ORDER BY c.device_time)), veh_max AS (SELECT o.device_id, COALESCE(v.max_speed, 70) AS max_speed FROM raw_business_data.objects o LEFT JOIN raw_business_data.vehicles v ON v.object_id = o.object_id WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.prev_kmh IS NOT NULL AND s.dt_sec > 0 AND s.dt_sec <= 120 AND (s.kmh - s.prev_kmh) / s.dt_sec >= 10) + COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.prev_kmh IS NOT NULL AND s.dt_sec > 0 AND s.dt_sec <= 120 AND (s.prev_kmh - s.kmh) / s.dt_sec >= 10) + COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.prev_lat IS NOT NULL AND s.kmh >= 30 AND ABS(atan2(sin(radians(s.lon - s.prev_lon)) * cos(radians(s.lat)), cos(radians(s.prev_lat)) * sin(radians(s.lat)) - sin(radians(s.prev_lat)) * cos(radians(s.lat)) * cos(radians(s.lon - s.prev_lon))) * 180 / pi()) >= 10 AND ABS(s.kmh - s.prev_kmh) >= 5) + COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.kmh > COALESCE(vm.max_speed, 70)) AS value FROM spd s LEFT JOIN veh_max vm ON vm.device_id = s.device_id

WITH spd AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT c.device_id, c.speed/100.0 AS kmh, c.latitude/1e7::numeric AS lat, c.longitude/1e7::numeric AS lon, LAG(c.speed/100.0) OVER w AS prev_kmh, LAG(c.latitude/1e7::numeric) OVER w AS prev_lat, LAG(c.longitude/1e7::numeric) OVER w AS prev_lon, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (c.device_time - LAG(c.device_time) OVER w)) AS dt_sec FROM raw_telematics_data.tracking_data_core c WHERE c.device_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND c.device_time < NOW() AND c.event_id IN (2, 802, 803, 804, 811) AND c.speed IS NOT NULL AND c.latitude <> 0 AND c.longitude <> 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_business_data.sensor_description sdc WHERE sdc.device_id = c.device_id AND sdc.sensor_type IN ('speed', 'acceleration')) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY c.device_id ORDER BY c.device_time)), veh_max AS (SELECT o.device_id, COALESCE(v.max_speed, 70) AS max_speed FROM raw_business_data.objects o LEFT JOIN raw_business_data.vehicles v ON v.object_id = o.object_id WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE), dv AS (SELECT s.device_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.prev_kmh IS NOT NULL AND s.dt_sec > 0 AND s.dt_sec <= 120 AND (s.kmh - s.prev_kmh) / s.dt_sec >= 10) AS accel_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.prev_kmh IS NOT NULL AND s.dt_sec > 0 AND s.dt_sec <= 120 AND (s.prev_kmh - s.kmh) / s.dt_sec >= 10) AS brake_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.prev_lat IS NOT NULL AND s.kmh >= 30 AND ABS(atan2(sin(radians(s.lon - s.prev_lon)) * cos(radians(s.lat)), cos(radians(s.prev_lat)) * sin(radians(s.lat)) - sin(radians(s.prev_lat)) * cos(radians(s.lat)) * cos(radians(s.lon - s.prev_lon))) * 180 / pi()) >= 10 AND ABS(s.kmh - s.prev_kmh) >= 5) AS turn_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.kmh > COALESCE(vm.max_speed, 70)) AS speed_cnt FROM spd s LEFT JOIN veh_max vm ON vm.device_id = s.device_id GROUP BY s.device_id), raw_inputs AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT i.device_id, i.device_time, i.value, sd.sensor_type, sd.sensor_label FROM raw_telematics_data.inputs i JOIN raw_business_data.sensor_description sd ON sd.device_id = i.device_id AND sd.input_label = i.sensor_name WHERE i.device_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND i.device_time < NOW() AND sd.sensor_type IN ('rpm', 'acceleration', 'engine')), ign AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT device_id, device_time, value::int AS ign_on FROM raw_telematics_data.states WHERE state_name = 'ignition' AND device_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND device_time < NOW() UNION ALL SELECT device_id, device_time, CASE WHEN value ~ '^[1-9]' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM raw_inputs WHERE sensor_type = 'engine'), iv AS (SELECT device_id, COUNT(*) AS idle_cnt FROM (SELECT device_id, device_time, ign_on, LEAD(device_time) OVER (PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY device_time) AS next_time FROM ign) m WHERE ign_on = 1 AND next_time IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (next_time - device_time)) / 60 >= 5 GROUP BY device_id), bv AS (SELECT device_id, COUNT(*) AS belt_cnt FROM raw_telematics_data.tracking_data_core WHERE device_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND device_time < NOW() AND event_id = 209 AND speed > 0 GROUP BY device_id), rv AS (SELECT device_id, COUNT(*) AS rpm_cnt FROM raw_inputs WHERE sensor_type = 'rpm' AND value ~ '^\d+\.?\d*$' AND value::numeric > 5000 GROUP BY device_id), accel_hw AS (SELECT device_id, COUNT(*) AS hw_accel_cnt FROM raw_inputs WHERE sensor_type = 'acceleration' AND value ~ '^\d+\.?\d*$' AND value::numeric > 2.78 GROUP BY device_id), vm AS (SELECT o.device_id, o.object_label, COALESCE(v.model, o.model, '—') AS vehicle_model, COALESCE(e.last_name || ' ' || e.first_name, '—') AS driver_name, ROUND(SUM(t.trip_distance_meters) / 1000.0, 2) AS mileage_km FROM raw_business_data.objects o LEFT JOIN raw_business_data.vehicles v ON v.object_id = o.object_id LEFT JOIN raw_business_data.employees e ON e.object_id = o.object_id AND e.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE LEFT JOIN processed_common_data.trips t ON t.device_id = o.device_id AND t.trip_start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND t.trip_start_time < NOW() WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE GROUP BY o.device_id, o.object_label, v.model, o.model, e.last_name, e.first_name HAVING COALESCE(SUM(t.trip_distance_meters), 0) > 0) SELECT vm.object_label AS vehicle, vm.driver_name, vm.vehicle_model, vm.mileage_km, ROUND(3.0 * (COALESCE(dv.accel_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(accel_hw.hw_accel_cnt, 0)) / vm.mileage_km * 100, 2) AS accel_score, ROUND(1.0 * COALESCE(dv.brake_cnt, 0) / vm.mileage_km * 100, 2) AS brake_score, ROUND(1.0 * COALESCE(dv.turn_cnt, 0) / vm.mileage_km * 100, 2) AS turn_score, ROUND(1.0 * COALESCE(iv.idle_cnt, 0) / vm.mileage_km * 100, 2) AS idle_score, ROUND(1.0 * COALESCE(bv.belt_cnt, 0) / vm.mileage_km * 100, 2) AS belt_score, ROUND(1.0 * COALESCE(rv.rpm_cnt, 0) / vm.mileage_km * 100, 2) AS rpm_score, ROUND(3.0 * COALESCE(dv.speed_cnt, 0) / vm.mileage_km * 100, 2) AS speed_score, GREATEST(0, ROUND((100 - 1.0 * COALESCE(dv.brake_cnt, 0) / vm.mileage_km * 100 - 1.0 * COALESCE(dv.turn_cnt, 0) / vm.mileage_km * 100 - 1.0 * COALESCE(iv.idle_cnt, 0) / vm.mileage_km * 100 - 1.0 * COALESCE(bv.belt_cnt, 0) / vm.mileage_km * 100 - 1.0 * COALESCE(rv.rpm_cnt, 0) / vm.mileage_km * 100 - 3.0 * COALESCE(dv.speed_cnt, 0) / vm.mileage_km * 100)::numeric, 2)) AS total_score FROM vm LEFT JOIN dv ON dv.device_id = vm.device_id LEFT JOIN iv ON iv.device_id = vm.device_id LEFT JOIN bv ON bv.device_id = vm.device_id LEFT JOIN rv ON rv.device_id = vm.device_id LEFT JOIN accel_hw ON accel_hw.device_id = vm.device_id ORDER BY total_score DESC LIMIT 500

WITH spd AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT c.device_id, c.speed/100.0 AS kmh, c.latitude/1e7::numeric AS lat, c.longitude/1e7::numeric AS lon, LAG(c.speed/100.0) OVER w AS prev_kmh, LAG(c.latitude/1e7::numeric) OVER w AS prev_lat, LAG(c.longitude/1e7::numeric) OVER w AS prev_lon, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (c.device_time - LAG(c.device_time) OVER w)) AS dt_sec FROM raw_telematics_data.tracking_data_core c WHERE c.device_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND c.device_time < NOW() AND c.event_id IN (2, 802, 803, 804, 811) AND c.speed IS NOT NULL AND c.latitude <> 0 AND c.longitude <> 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_business_data.sensor_description sdc WHERE sdc.device_id = c.device_id AND sdc.sensor_type IN ('speed', 'acceleration')) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY c.device_id ORDER BY c.device_time)), veh_max AS (SELECT o.device_id, COALESCE(v.max_speed, 70) AS max_speed FROM raw_business_data.objects o LEFT JOIN raw_business_data.vehicles v ON v.object_id = o.object_id WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE), dv AS (SELECT s.device_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.prev_kmh IS NOT NULL AND s.dt_sec > 0 AND s.dt_sec <= 120 AND (s.kmh - s.prev_kmh) / s.dt_sec >= 10) AS accel_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.prev_kmh IS NOT NULL AND s.dt_sec > 0 AND s.dt_sec <= 120 AND (s.prev_kmh - s.kmh) / s.dt_sec >= 10) AS brake_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.prev_lat IS NOT NULL AND s.kmh >= 30 AND ABS(atan2(sin(radians(s.lon - s.prev_lon)) * cos(radians(s.lat)), cos(radians(s.prev_lat)) * sin(radians(s.lat)) - sin(radians(s.prev_lat)) * cos(radians(s.lat)) * cos(radians(s.lon - s.prev_lon))) * 180 / pi()) >= 10 AND ABS(s.kmh - s.prev_kmh) >= 5) AS turn_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.kmh > COALESCE(vm.max_speed, 70)) AS speed_cnt FROM spd s LEFT JOIN veh_max vm ON vm.device_id = s.device_id GROUP BY s.device_id), raw_inputs AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT i.device_id, i.device_time, i.value, sd.sensor_type, sd.sensor_label FROM raw_telematics_data.inputs i JOIN raw_business_data.sensor_description sd ON sd.device_id = i.device_id AND sd.input_label = i.sensor_name WHERE i.device_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND i.device_time < NOW() AND sd.sensor_type IN ('rpm', 'acceleration', 'engine')), ign AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT device_id, device_time, value::int AS ign_on FROM raw_telematics_data.states WHERE state_name = 'ignition' AND device_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND device_time < NOW() UNION ALL SELECT device_id, device_time, CASE WHEN value ~ '^[1-9]' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM raw_inputs WHERE sensor_type = 'engine'), iv AS (SELECT device_id, COUNT(*) AS idle_cnt FROM (SELECT device_id, device_time, ign_on, LEAD(device_time) OVER (PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY device_time) AS next_time FROM ign) m WHERE ign_on = 1 AND next_time IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (next_time - device_time)) / 60 >= 5 GROUP BY device_id), bv AS (SELECT device_id, COUNT(*) AS belt_cnt FROM raw_telematics_data.tracking_data_core WHERE device_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND device_time < NOW() AND event_id = 209 AND speed > 0 GROUP BY device_id), rv AS (SELECT device_id, COUNT(*) AS rpm_cnt FROM raw_inputs WHERE sensor_type = 'rpm' AND value ~ '^\d+\.?\d*$' AND value::numeric > 5000 GROUP BY device_id), accel_hw AS (SELECT device_id, COUNT(*) AS hw_accel_cnt FROM raw_inputs WHERE sensor_type = 'acceleration' AND value ~ '^\d+\.?\d*$' AND value::numeric > 2.78 GROUP BY device_id), vi AS (SELECT o.device_id, o.object_label, COALESCE(e.last_name || ' ' || e.first_name, '—') AS driver_name, COALESCE(g.group_label, '—') AS group_label FROM raw_business_data.objects o LEFT JOIN raw_business_data.employees e ON e.object_id = o.object_id AND e.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE LEFT JOIN raw_business_data.groups g ON g.group_id = o.group_id WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE) SELECT vi.object_label AS vehicle, vi.driver_name, vi.group_label, COALESCE(dv.accel_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(accel_hw.hw_accel_cnt, 0) AS acceleration, COALESCE(dv.brake_cnt, 0) AS braking, COALESCE(dv.turn_cnt, 0) AS sharp_turn, COALESCE(iv.idle_cnt, 0) AS idle, COALESCE(bv.belt_cnt, 0) AS seatbelt, COALESCE(rv.rpm_cnt, 0) AS rpm_exceeded, COALESCE(dv.speed_cnt, 0) AS speeding FROM vi LEFT JOIN dv ON dv.device_id = vi.device_id LEFT JOIN iv ON iv.device_id = vi.device_id LEFT JOIN bv ON bv.device_id = vi.device_id LEFT JOIN rv ON rv.device_id = vi.device_id LEFT JOIN accel_hw ON accel_hw.device_id = vi.device_id WHERE COALESCE(dv.accel_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(accel_hw.hw_accel_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(dv.brake_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(dv.turn_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(iv.idle_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(bv.belt_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(rv.rpm_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(dv.speed_cnt, 0) > 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(dv.accel_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(accel_hw.hw_accel_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(dv.brake_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(dv.turn_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(iv.idle_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(bv.belt_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(rv.rpm_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(dv.speed_cnt, 0) DESC LIMIT 500

WITH spd AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT c.device_id, c.device_time, c.speed/100.0 AS kmh, c.latitude/1e7::numeric AS lat, c.longitude/1e7::numeric AS lon, LAG(c.speed/100.0) OVER w AS prev_kmh, LAG(c.latitude/1e7::numeric) OVER w AS prev_lat, LAG(c.longitude/1e7::numeric) OVER w AS prev_lon, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (c.device_time - LAG(c.device_time) OVER w)) AS dt_sec FROM raw_telematics_data.tracking_data_core c WHERE c.device_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND c.device_time < NOW() AND c.event_id IN (2, 802, 803, 804, 811) AND c.speed IS NOT NULL AND c.latitude <> 0 AND c.longitude <> 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_business_data.sensor_description sdc WHERE sdc.device_id = c.device_id AND sdc.sensor_type IN ('speed', 'acceleration')) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY c.device_id ORDER BY c.device_time)), veh_max AS (SELECT o.device_id, COALESCE(v.max_speed, 70) AS max_speed FROM raw_business_data.objects o LEFT JOIN raw_business_data.vehicles v ON v.object_id = o.object_id WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE), raw_inputs AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT i.device_id, i.device_time, i.value, sd.sensor_type, sd.sensor_label FROM raw_telematics_data.inputs i JOIN raw_business_data.sensor_description sd ON sd.device_id = i.device_id AND sd.input_label = i.sensor_name WHERE i.device_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND i.device_time < NOW() AND sd.sensor_type IN ('rpm', 'acceleration', 'engine')), ign AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT device_id, device_time, value::int AS ign_on FROM raw_telematics_data.states WHERE state_name = 'ignition' AND device_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND device_time < NOW() UNION ALL SELECT device_id, device_time, CASE WHEN value ~ '^[1-9]' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM raw_inputs WHERE sensor_type = 'engine'), idle_calc AS (SELECT device_id, device_time, ign_on, LEAD(device_time) OVER (PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY device_time) AS next_time FROM ign), obj AS (SELECT o.device_id, o.object_label, COALESCE(e.last_name || ' ' || e.first_name, '—') AS driver_name, COALESCE(g.group_label, '—') AS group_label FROM raw_business_data.objects o LEFT JOIN raw_business_data.employees e ON e.object_id = o.object_id AND e.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE LEFT JOIN raw_business_data.groups g ON g.group_id = o.group_id WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE), events AS (SELECT s.device_time AS vtime, s.device_id, 'Speeding' AS event, 'Limit ' || vm.max_speed::int || ' km/h, actual ' || ROUND(s.kmh::numeric, 0)::int || ' km/h' AS violation_type, ROUND(s.lat::numeric, 6) AS lat, ROUND(s.lon::numeric, 6) AS lon, ROUND(s.kmh::numeric, 2) AS speed_kmh FROM spd s JOIN veh_max vm ON vm.device_id = s.device_id WHERE s.kmh > vm.max_speed UNION ALL SELECT device_time, device_id, 'Harsh Acceleration', 'Acceleration ' || ROUND(((kmh - prev_kmh) / dt_sec)::numeric, 1) || ' km/h/s', ROUND(lat::numeric, 6), ROUND(lon::numeric, 6), ROUND(kmh::numeric, 2) FROM spd WHERE prev_kmh IS NOT NULL AND dt_sec > 0 AND dt_sec <= 120 AND (kmh - prev_kmh) / dt_sec >= 10 UNION ALL SELECT device_time, device_id, 'Harsh Braking', 'Braking ' || ROUND(((prev_kmh - kmh) / dt_sec)::numeric, 1) || ' km/h/s', ROUND(lat::numeric, 6), ROUND(lon::numeric, 6), ROUND(kmh::numeric, 2) FROM spd WHERE prev_kmh IS NOT NULL AND dt_sec > 0 AND dt_sec <= 120 AND (prev_kmh - kmh) / dt_sec >= 10 UNION ALL SELECT device_time, device_id, 'Sharp Turn', 'Heading change >=10 deg', ROUND(lat::numeric, 6), ROUND(lon::numeric, 6), ROUND(kmh::numeric, 2) FROM spd WHERE prev_lat IS NOT NULL AND kmh >= 30 AND ABS(atan2(sin(radians(lon - prev_lon)) * cos(radians(lat)), cos(radians(prev_lat)) * sin(radians(lat)) - sin(radians(prev_lat)) * cos(radians(lat)) * cos(radians(lon - prev_lon))) * 180 / pi()) >= 10 AND ABS(kmh - prev_kmh) >= 5 UNION ALL SELECT device_time, device_id, 'Idling', 'Idle ' || ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (next_time - device_time)) / 60)::numeric, 0)::int || ' min', NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric FROM idle_calc WHERE ign_on = 1 AND next_time IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (next_time - device_time)) / 60 >= 5 UNION ALL SELECT c.device_time, c.device_id, 'Seatbelt', 'Moving without seatbelt', ROUND((c.latitude/1e7::numeric)::numeric, 6), ROUND((c.longitude/1e7::numeric)::numeric, 6), ROUND((c.speed/100.0)::numeric, 2) FROM raw_telematics_data.tracking_data_core c WHERE c.device_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND c.device_time < NOW() AND c.event_id = 209 AND c.speed > 0 UNION ALL SELECT device_time, device_id, 'RPM Exceeded', 'RPM ' || ROUND(value::numeric, 0)::int, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric FROM raw_inputs WHERE sensor_type = 'rpm' AND value ~ '^\d+\.?\d*$' AND value::numeric > 5000 UNION ALL SELECT device_time, device_id, 'Harsh Acceleration (sensor)', 'HW ' || ROUND(value::numeric, 2) || ' m/s2', NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric FROM raw_inputs WHERE sensor_type = 'acceleration' AND value ~ '^\d+\.?\d*$' AND value::numeric > 2.78) SELECT to_char(e.vtime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS violation_time, o.group_label, e.event, e.violation_type, e.lat AS latitude, e.lon AS longitude, e.speed_kmh, o.driver_name, COALESCE(o.object_label, 'device_' || e.device_id) AS vehicle FROM events e JOIN obj o ON o.device_id = e.device_id ORDER BY e.vtime DESC LIMIT 500

description: Driving Score Dashboard — 3 tables: Vehicle Rating, Violation Counts, Violations Detail. TimescaleDB optimized: MATERIALIZED CTEs for spd/raw_inputs/ign; explicit upper bound device_time < NOW() for precise chunk exclusion; each TimescaleDB table scanned exactly once per query.
